name: Hanze University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences university in Groningen with 16 English-taught programmes, from business and engineering to its conservatoire and art academy.

ib.text: The IB Diploma meets the HAVO-level entry for 4-year programmes and counts as VWO-level for the 3-year ones. It also exempts you from the English test.

dates.label: General application deadline, non-EU students (September 2027 start)
General application deadline, EU students (September 2027 start)

programmes.name: Classical Music
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Audition (video pre-selection for violin, voice, piano); apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.

programmes.name: Creative Media & Game Technologies
programmes.ib: Maths required (any passing grade; Hanze sets no IB level).

programmes.name: Design
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, then home assignment and interview; portfolio due 1 June in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical and Electronic Engineering
programmes.ib: Maths required (Hanze sets no IB level). Majors from year 3: Mechatronics, Sensors & Smart Systems, Energy & Power Electronics.

programmes.name: Fine Art
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio, motivation letter and CV uploaded in Hanze Apply by 1 June 2027, then an admission interview.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.ib: IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead. Applying after 1 May means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The four-year BBA. Hanze says IB Diploma holders may take the 3-year version instead.
family.cardLine: Also open to you; a year longer

programmes.name: International Business (3-year)
programmes.ib: For VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma. Applying after 1 May means a compulsory Study Choice Check.

family.name: International Business
family.differs: The three-year BBA, for VWO-level diplomas such as the IB Diploma.
family.cardLine: Open to you with the IB Diploma

programmes.name: Jazz
programmes.ib: Prince Claus Conservatoire; taught in Dutch and English. Video pre-selection, then audition; apply by 1 March in 2026, 2027 date not yet published.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry: Maths and Physics "at advanced level" (Hanze gives no HL/SL rule). EU applicants apply by 1 July.

programmes.name: Physiotherapy
programmes.ib: International Physiotherapy Programme, selective: apply by 15 January, then a registration form, tests and an online selection day in February.

programmes.name: Popular Culture
programmes.ib: Minerva Art Academy; taught in Dutch and English. Portfolio with a one-minute video, then an admission assessment; 2027 admission dates not yet published.

programmes.name: Sport Studies
programmes.ib: VWO-level entry (IB Diploma). Apply by 15 June; online matching day and a sports medical fitness test.

notes: The Prince Claus Conservatoire and Minerva Art Academy are part of Hanze: you apply through Studielink, but an audition or portfolio decides, with earlier deadlines.
With an IB Diploma you can take the 3-year International Business, Mechanical Engineering or Sport Studies, which are meant for VWO-level students.
Popular Culture is taught in Leeuwarden, not Groningen.
